title: Regateando una cazadora en El Rastro

dialogue.speaker: Marta
dialogue.spanish: ¡Oye, Dani, mira qué cazadora de cuero tan chula tienen colgada en este puesto del Rastro!
dialogue.english: Hey, Dani, look what a cool leather jacket they have hanging at this stall in El Rastro!

slang.actualMeaning: so cool / stylish / pretty (everyday Spain slang)
slang.example: ¡Qué zapatillas tan chulas te has comprado!

dialogue.speaker: Dani
dialogue.spanish: Pues te queda genial de talla, tía. Pregúntale al chico cuánto pide por ella.
dialogue.english: Well it fits you great, girl. Ask the guy how much he's asking for it.

dialogue.speaker: Marta
dialogue.spanish: Bueno, dice que son sesenta pavos, pero tiene un pequeño roce aquí en el bolsillo.
dialogue.english: Well, he says it's sixty bucks, but it has a small scuff right here on the pocket.

slang.actualMeaning: sixty euros / bucks (colloquial Spain slang for euros)
slang.example: La entrada del festival me costó cincuenta pavos.

dialogue.speaker: Dani
dialogue.spanish: O sea, sesenta es un poco caro para ser de segunda mano. Dile que le das cuarenta en efectivo ahora mismo.
dialogue.english: I mean, sixty is a bit pricey for secondhand. Tell him you'll give him forty in cash right now.

dialogue.speaker: Marta
dialogue.spanish: Vale, hemos cerrado el trato en cuarenta y cinco euros y me regala este pañuelo de seda.
dialogue.english: Okay, we closed the deal at forty-five euros and he's throwing in this silk scarf for free.

dialogue.speaker: Dani
dialogue.spanish: ¡Qué triunfada, tía! Venga, vamos a tomar un vermut con aceitunas en la plaza de Cascorro.
dialogue.english: What a score, girl! Come on, let's go grab a vermouth with olives at Cascorro square.

questions.question: What item is Marta buying at El Rastro flea market in Madrid?
options: A secondhand leather jacket ('una cazadora de cuero')
questions.explanation: Marta spots 'qué cazadora de cuero tan chula' hanging at the market stall.

questions.question: What was the seller's initial price, and what final price do they agree on?
options: Initially 60 euros; they settle on 45 euros plus a free silk scarf
Initially 100 euros; they settle on 80 euros
Initially 40 euros; Marta pays the full 40 euros
Initially 50 euros; they settle on 25 euros
questions.explanation: The seller initially asks for 'sesenta pavos' (60 euros), and Marta bargains down to 45 euros plus a silk scarf.

questions.question: Where do Dani and Marta head after buying the jacket?
options: To Cascorro square to have vermouth and olives
To the subway station to go home
To a shoe store on Gran Vía
questions.explanation: Dani says: 'vamos a tomar un vermut con aceitunas en la plaza de Cascorro.'

questions.question: Slang Side Quest: In Spain, what do 'tan chula' and 'sesenta pavos' mean?
questions.explanation: In Spain, 'chulo/chula' means cool or stylish, and 'pavos' (literally turkeys) is slang for euros/bucks!
